name: Onyx
kurzbeschreibung:
**Onyx in Wörgl**

Discover the fascinating world of **Onyx** in **Wörgl**, a town in **Tirol** where this precious stone is mined and crafted into stunning jewelry and decorative pieces. The **Onyx** mines near **Wörgl** have been a source of wonder for centuries, offering visitors a glimpse into the geological wonders beneath the earth’s surface.

At the **Onyx Museum** in **Wörgl**, you can explore the history of **Onyx** mining, see impressive raw stones, and admire beautifully crafted pieces. The museum also features a small shop where you can purchase unique souvenirs made from local **Onyx**.

For those interested in geology, guided tours of the **Onyx** mines provide an unforgettable experience. Descend into the underground tunnels and marvel at the natural beauty of this rare stone. Whether you're a collector, a jewelry lover, or simply curious, **Onyx in Wörgl** promises an exciting adventure.

After your visit, treat yourself to a traditional **Tiroler** meal at one of the cozy restaurants in **Wörgl**. Pair your **Kaiserschmarrn** or **Tiroler Gröstl** with a glass of local **Tiroler** wine for the perfect conclusion to your day.
